source.method: sparql:SELECT ?item ?itemLabel ?article ?sitelinks ?length ?countryLabel WHERE { { SELECT ?item (MAX(?l) AS ?length) (SAMPLE(?c) AS ?country) WHERE { ?item wdt:P31 wd:Q4022 ; p:P2043/psn:P2043/wikibase:quantityAmount ?l ; wdt:P17 ?c . FILTER(?l >= 100000) FILTER NOT EXISTS { ?item wdt:P17 ?c2 . FILTER(?c2 != ?c) } } GROUP BY ?item HAVING(COUNT(DISTINCT ?c) = 1) } hint:Prior hint:runFirst true . OPTIONAL { ?article schema:about ?item ; schema:isPartOf <https://en.wikipedia.org/> . } ?item wikibase:sitelinks ?sitelinks . SERVICE wikibase:label { bd:serviceParam wikibase:language "en,mul". } } ORDER BY DESC(?sitelinks) LIMIT 160

rows.label: Mississippi River

rows.label: Ganges

rows.label: River Thames

rows.label: Yangtze River
rows.description: Longest river in Asia, and the third-longest in the world
rows.hook: is the longest river in Asia and is crossed by the enormous Three Gorges Dam

rows.label: Yellow River
rows.hook: is called the cradle of an ancient civilization and carries so much silt it runs muddy

rows.label: Hudson River
rows.description: river in New York State, United States

rows.label: Ohio River
rows.description: river in the midwestern United States

rows.label: Volga
rows.description: river in Russia; the longest river in Europe

rows.label: Missouri River

rows.label: Seine

rows.label: Potomac River

rows.label: Snake River

rows.label: River Severn

rows.label: Susquehanna River

rows.label: Vistula
